orders.title: Road Closure-NFSR 735A-9
orders.summary: Effective July 10, 2026 at 5:00 PM MDT, the Medora Ranger District has closed National Forest System Road (NFSR) 735A‑9 due to road damage that poses public safety concerns. The closure will remain in place through December 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM MST, unless rescinded earlier.
